name: Pendulum Blades
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: Several swinging pendulums mounted with razor-sharp blades extend from the ceiling and slice into the room below.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check to jam the gears and prevent the trap from being activated

offensiveAbilities.name: Swinging Blades
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger This trap must be manually activated by a creature adjacent to the southwest gear stack;

Effect Blades swing down to strike at all creatures in area F2 before wrenching to a frozen halt against the opposite walls. All creatures in the central part of this room take 6d6 + 3 slashing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save).
